Lanza una venda a lo que tenga delante y: Throws a bandage at whatever is in front and above (a wall, a roof or a tree) and swings hanging from it. Power again: lets go with a push, and in the air can throw another to chain them. Hold Jump: reels in the bandage and goes up; if it's hooked on the edge of a flat roof, it leaves you on top. Fire with Power, Jump or Action: you fly up to 120 m and the glider opens on the way down. Put away (Sprint) removes the cannon without firing.

With Action it howls: the moon shines for a moment, any Halloween apparitions nearby run away and the horses neigh. In a room your friends see the wolf and hear the howl.

On the edge of a flat roof, Power goes down hanging from a thread you can see: it goes down by itself, joystick back goes down and forward goes up; if you let go of the joystick or press Jump, it stops, and Power again lets go. With no wall in front or edge, the button tells you.

<h3>Poderes de los disfraces</h3><p clas:
Costume powers

Each costume has its power, in both worlds and with or without Halloween night, while you're wearing it. The Power button (above Sprint, with the costume's icon), △ / Y on the controller or the Q key. The ring on the button fills up while it recharges (a few seconds) and, for powers with a time limit, empties while it lasts.
<li><b>Poderes de los disfraces</b> (con: • Costume powers (with a Halloween costume on, in both worlds): the Power button above Sprint, △ / Y on the controller or the Q key. A ring round the button fills up while it recharges and empties while the power lasts. Mummy: throws a bandage at a wall, a roof or a tree and swings (hold Jump to go up; Power to let go and throw another in the air). Witch: flies on her broom (Up, Down and the joystick; it stays still if you let go) and a friend can get on behind. Dracula: a bat for 25 seconds, low and fast, and with the cape he glides when falling from high up (hold Jump). Ghost: 12 seconds going through walls, doors and trees; if it ends inside something it comes out by itself at the nearest free spot, and the apparitions don't scare it. Skeleton: falls apart and puts itself back together up to 20 m further on. Pumpkin: rolls (downhill it speeds up, Jump bounces). Pirate: a cannon with the arc of the shot showing; you fly up to 120 m and the glider opens on the way down. Werewolf: turns for 30 seconds into a big wolf that runs fast, jumps far, swims and howls with Action (the moon shines, the apparitions run away and the horses neigh). Spider: facing a wall it climbs up with the joystick (Jump lets go) and goes onto the flat roof; on the edge of a flat roof it goes down hanging from a thread (joystick back goes down, forward goes up, let go to stop; Power lets go). In a room your friends see your power.
